ZK proof verification and context-state close handling for ElGamal proof instructions.

# Purpose
This C file implements instruction handlers for the `zk-elgamal-proof` program in the executor. The function [`fd_zksdk_process_verify_proof`](<#fd_zksdk_process_verify_proof>) decodes a ZK proof verification instruction, selects the matching verifier from the `fd_zksdk_instr_verify_proof_*` set, loads proof data either from instruction data or from an account, and then calls the selected verifier. It also supports creating a proof context account when the instruction includes extra accounts, and it writes the context header and context data into that account after it checks the owner, size, and initialization state.

The function [`fd_zksdk_process_close_context_state`](<#fd_zksdk_process_close_context_state>) handles closing a proof context account. It checks that the owner account signed the instruction, reads the proof context authority from the proof account, verifies that the destination account is not the same as the proof account, and then checks that the owner matches the stored context authority. After these checks, it transfers all lamports from the proof account to the destination account, clears the proof account data, sets its lamports to zero, and assigns the account to the system program.
